(1) Equilibrium rulings window: a fixture at ceiling = base + H that moves at least one Decision persists ceiling equal to min(previous ceiling, pre-move base + H_new) and a window of Delta_retired + H_new when that term sets the ceiling. Do not assert window = previous_window + Delta_retired unconditionally — that equality holds only while the previous ceiling binds. window_gain = Delta_retired - (H_old - H_new) where the formula term binds. The shipped post-move call fails this probe. (2) Anti-ratchet: a fixture whose Base_live + H_new exceeds the persisted ceiling keeps the previous ceiling.
